top_concerns: Selection bias/circularity: questions filtered against the same top agents later ranked; uniqueness checked only against alternatives those agents produced; no independent label-noise audit or human solve rate

Key findings come from confounded comparisons (R1 API without search vs DeepSeek consumer product with search; GPT-4o grading for LLMs vs human GUI grading for products), so causal claims are unsupported
No confidence intervals or repeated runs at N=289; several claimed gaps are within noise; product results are not reproducible

Shallow analysis: no error taxonomy, per-topic results, or evidence that difficulty comes from Chinese-specific properties rather than obscure long-tail knowledge; calibration claims inconsistent with Table 1
Small, annotator-interest-driven dataset with contamination/stability risk and dated model set
